description.text: Research direction: Chinese Music History, Vocal Music Singing and Teaching, Violin Performance and Teaching, Piano Performance and Teaching, Appreciation and Comment of Music, Chorus Command, Dancing Education, Flute's Performance and Teaching, Musical Anthropology, Mucial Asthetics and Er Hu's Performance and Teaching

duration.text: The Musicology at Shanghai Normal University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year
